units.rawText: After being with you for a while, I've found you to be more amusing than the many tales of the strange.
units.displayText: After being with you for a while, I've found you to be more amusing than the many tales of the strange.

spans.text: After being with you for a while, I've found you to be more amusing than the many tales of the strange.

units.rawText: This is by no means a critique of your character; becoming "amusing" in the eyes of others is not an easy task by any means.
units.displayText: This is by no means a critique of your character; becoming "amusing" in the eyes of others is not an easy task by any means.

spans.text: This is by no means a critique of your character; becoming "amusing" in the eyes of others is not an easy task by any means.

units.rawText: It represents how traveling with you is enjoyable and extraordinary, surprising yet reassuring, much like the ever-hungry snake that grows longer and longer and whose next turn can never be predicted.

spans.text: It represents how traveling with you is enjoyable and extraordinary, surprising yet reassuring, much like the ever-hungry snake that grows longer and longer and whose next turn can never be predicted.

units.rawText: Strange tales like these are the kind that I most enjoy studying.
units.displayText: Strange tales like these are the kind that I most enjoy studying.

spans.text: Strange tales like these are the kind that I most enjoy studying.

units.rawText: That is why I hope you will allow me to get closer to you and continue my studies.
